summary: Iteration 2 tested new admin auth + estimate inbox + photo upload + Before/After gallery. Backend pytest suite expanded to 11 tests (100% pass): auth (login success/fail, /auth/me with/without token, /api/estimates 401 unauth vs 200 authed), uploads (single, multiple, missing 404, serve returns image bytes with image/* content-type), estimates with photos persisted end-to-end and visible in authed list. Frontend Playwright: landing hero visible, before-after-section renders all 3 sliders (before-after-0/1/2), estimate form filled + photo uploaded via hidden input (thumbnail in estimate-photo-list) + submit yields estimate-success. Admin /admin login: wrong password shows 'Invalid email or password' toast; correct creds load Estimate Inbox with estimate-count '4 total', inbox-item-0 visible, 2 photo thumbnails from prior submissions; logout returns to login view.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/uploads has NO auth and NO file-size/type validation - a public unauthenticated endpoint that accepts any bytes and pushes them to object storage is an abuse vector (bandwidth, storage cost). Recommend: enforce MIME whitelist against MIME_TYPES, cap per-file bytes (~10MB), cap total files per request (~10), and optionally rate-limit by IP.

server.py: seed_reviews from iteration_1 was replaced but the file no longer contains reviews-related endpoints referenced in the previous test file - the current backend_test.py has been updated accordingly. Confirm reviews were intentionally removed.

server.py: send_email is awaited sequentially inside POST /api/estimates - two blocking HTTP calls (~1-3s each on cold path) delay the response. Consider asyncio.gather or fire-and-forget via BackgroundTasks so the customer sees immediate success.
AdminInbox.jsx: token is persisted in localStorage (XSS-readable). For an owner-only inbox this is acceptable but httpOnly cookie would be more secure; backend already supports cookie fallback.
EstimateForm.jsx: photo upload has no client-side size/type guard - relies entirely on server (which also lacks one). Add accept validation + max size check for UX.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded a few TEST_ 1x1 PNGs to object storage and created 2 TEST_ estimates with photos during testing (visible in admin inbox). Reviews collection unrelated to this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend auth uses Bearer tokens (Authorization header); httpOnly cookie fallback also supported by get_current_user. Uploads endpoint is public - be mindful when testing. Emails go to Emergent Resend integration; send failures are swallowed and don't fail POST /api/estimates. Admin seed runs on startup and resets password from .env when it changes.
